scope: Coarse held-out mechanics diagnostics for the complete 94-atom ACE-Cys(sotorasib)-NME product; no fragment substitution, parameter refitting or physical acceptance from numerical convergence alone.
requires: Qualify an informative, affordable dispersion-corrected reference strategy before executing the six long HF diagnostic optimizations; see the separate bounded feasibility review.
Actual accepted full-parent optimization with preserved product graph, stereo and frozen cap coordinates
Completed exact-HF ESP and constrained native RESP; actual charges replace all synthetic charge fixtures
Native ff14SB/GAFF2 interface precedence, complete term inventory and matched-engine energy/force checks for those actual charges
baseline: Use the final full-parent DF geometry, state, atom order and exact recorded cap freezes. All targets are periodic offsets from the measured optimized baseline angle.

first_stage.name: sulfur_ligand_attachment
first_stage.purpose: Probe local attachment softness in both directions and one widely separated orientation. Three offsets do not locate all minima or the rotational barrier.

first_stage.name: reacted_ligand_linker
first_stage.purpose: Probe flexibility adjacent to the newly saturated warhead, retaining the complete actual ligand electronic and steric environment.

quantum_method.geometry: Explicit DF-RHF/6-31G* (spherical), def2-universal-jkfit, full closed-shell neutral adduct
quantum_method.state: Same charge/spin and complete product graph as accepted parent
quantum_method.constraints: The same five cap heavy Cartesian coordinates plus one explicit dihedral target per job; require actual final periodic-angle and cap checks
quantum_method.initial_density: Verified accepted parent checkpoint at exactly the same initial geometry; never use a density from an unverified rotated geometry
quantum_method.limitations: The measured DF error at one parent geometry is not a bound on conformational energies. RHF omits electron correlation and dispersion; profiles are declared model diagnostics, not experimental free-energy surfaces or sufficient chemical validation.

bounds.large_df_policy: Sequential by default; no concurrent large DF jobs unless more than 30 GiB free disk and the existing process/memory limits also permit it. Current parent optimizer has demonstrated approximately 12 GiB temporary DF storage.
bounds.launch_policy: Prepare requests only now; launch the two near-angle attachment diagnostics first after the required parent evidence, inspect actual convergence/cost, then proceed to the remaining frozen targets. Keep failures and do not add replacement targets to inflate completion.

comparison.classical: Evaluate the unchanged full native force field with actual joint RESP charges at each exact QM geometry, and use the identical parent baseline; retain component energies and all original atom identities.
comparison.reference: Record QM and MM relative energies separately, target/final angles, companion torsion changes, bonded geometry and stereo. Retain unsuccessful conformers in the planned six-point denominator.
comparison.held_out: Do not fit or tune torsions using these same points and then call their agreement validation. Any parameter revision needs separate held-out geometries.
comparison.acceptance: No automatic accuracy threshold or full-preparation acceptance is attached to this coarse plan. Unexpected stiffness, favorable high-strain conformers, incorrect minima or large relative-energy disagreement require investigation.
